en.title: Movify.pe - Infrastructure Migration to AWS
en.shortDescription: Infrastructure migration to AWS to improve deployment and availability.
en.description: From July to November 2023, I led the infrastructure migration to AWS to enhance deployment, availability, and service reliability. I established CI/CD workflows for deployment on AWS services, automating pipelines. I integrated Amazon S3 for storing photos and videos related to moving services.

projectGoals.title: Migration to AWS
projectGoals.description: Migrate the infrastructure to AWS to improve deployment and service availability.

projectGoals.title: Storage Solution
projectGoals.description: Find storage solutions for photos and videos.

keyFeatures.title: AWS Infrastructure
keyFeatures.description: Migration to AWS Amplify, Amazon RDS, EC2, and S3 to enhance availability and scalability.

keyFeatures.title: Automated CI/CD Workflows
keyFeatures.description: CI/CD automation for continuous deployment on AWS services using GitHub Actions.

keyFeatures.title: Storage on Amazon S3
keyFeatures.description: Integration with Amazon S3 to store photos and videos related to moving services.

es.title: Movify.pe - Migración de Infraestructura a AWS
es.shortDescription: Migración de infraestructura a AWS para mejorar el despliegue y la disponibilidad.
es.description: De julio a noviembre de 2023, lideré la migración de la infraestructura a AWS para mejorar el despliegue, la disponibilidad y la confiabilidad de los servicios clave. Establecí flujos de CI/CD para desplegar en servicios de AWS y automaticé los pipelines. Integré Amazon S3 para almacenar fotos y videos relacionados con los servicios de mudanza.
